observation: A universal worker can fail before its first durable beacon. In that case GitHub contains no worker evidence, the ChatGPT worker visibly returns a boundary, and Primary Chat can otherwise wait forever because it only sees durable state. The user then becomes the failure detector/message bus.
recovered_related_patterns: candidate write safety denial after claim
return receipt not persisted after work completed
UI appears thinking/stopped while durable state is ambiguous
successful durable CLOSE exists but user sees only chat completion
gap: Current public control flow models durable worker state well, but not pre-durable launch attempts or chat-visible-only terminal boundaries.

transitions: no durable signal within bounded window -> UNCONFIRMED_TIMEOUT, never infinite spinner
one isolated pre-beacon transport/safety boundary -> allow one identical fresh-shell retry
same blocker repeated >=2 -> GUIDE_RESCATE / mechanism investigation; stop blind retries

page_rule: Primary Chat must always show whether it is waiting for durable evidence, has confirmed a worker, suspects a pre-beacon failure, or needs human attention. An absence of evidence must never render as indefinite passive waiting.
chat_history_rule: When the controlling ChatGPT session is active, recent project worker chats may be harvested as secondary evidence for chat-visible-only boundaries and reduced into public-safe incident summaries. This is not yet an unattended public-page capability and must not be represented as one.
no_extra_roundtrip_rule: Use existing thread polling/durable projections for confirmed state. Pre-beacon watchdog can be local/client-side timing. Do not add a remote API call per second or per decision.
escalation_rule: Repeated same-class launch failure is a GUIDE_RESCATE trigger, not a reason to ask the human to keep retrying indefinitely.
